itinerary.cal: Same NPS backcountry permit zone as the Southwest Couloir; route is best after roughly the third week of July, since accessing the toe of the buttress off the glacier gets harder as the season's moat/bergschrund opens.

days.note: PCT south from the Bridge Creek trailhead, then up North Fork Bridge Creek (ford required), finishing with brushy/alder off-trail travel to a camp near the glacier toe (~6,400-6,800 ft). Expect mosquitoes and a slow final half-mile.
days.title: Approach to high camp
days.objective: Reach camp near the toe of the Goode Glacier

days.note: Cross the glacier and deal with the moat/bergschrund onto the buttress, then simul-climb the lower 4th-class crest before roping up for several pitches of low 5th class (5.4-5.6) to the summit. Most parties reach the top roughly 8 hours after leaving camp and bivy there.

itinerary.cal: Jun-Jul. Commonly done as a 3-day trip that depends on the Lady of the Lake ferry or a floatplane to Stehekin and the valley shuttle to High Bridge. An alternate approach via Hemlock Camp, about 12.5 miles south on the PCT, is reported as substantially easier because it avoids most of the Swamp Creek brush.

days.note: Take the ferry or a floatplane to Stehekin and the shuttle to High Bridge. Hike the Agnes Creek Trail (PCT) about 5-5.5 miles to Fivemile Camp or 8-9 miles to Swamp Creek Camp, or continue toward Hemlock Camp on the alternate approach.
days.title: Ferry, shuttle, and hike up Agnes Creek
days.objective: Reach Swamp Creek or Fivemile Camp

days.note: This is a long, strenuous summit day: bushwhack up Swamp Creek and travel cross-country to Dark Fin Col, then rope up across the Dark Glacier and belay the moat crossing before a short scramble to the summit. Reverse the entire route back to camp.
days.title: Summit Dark Peak
days.objective: Cross the Dark Glacier to the summit and return

days.note: Hike out to High Bridge and catch the return shuttle and ferry to Chelan.
days.title: Hike out to High Bridge
days.objective: Catch the shuttle and ferry back to Chelan

itinerary.totalNote: Ferry and shuttle to High Bridge and hike up Agnes Creek to camp, make a long summit day over Dark Fin Col and the Dark Glacier, then hike out to catch the shuttle and ferry.

itinerary.cal: The route is typically climbed June-September once the Cathedral Pass trail and Daniel Glacier snow are in reasonable shape.

days.note: From the Cathedral Rock Trailhead (~3,350 ft), climb steadily via Squaw Lake and over Cathedral Pass (~5,600 ft) before dropping slightly to camp at Peggy's Pond (~5,560 ft). Trail is well-graded switchbacks up to the pass, then a rougher/fainter path along the basin to the pond.
days.title: Approach to Peggy's Pond
days.objective: Backpack in to high camp at Peggy's Pond

days.note: Alpine start from Peggy's Pond, ascend on trail/snow toward the SE ridge and onto the Daniel Glacier to reach the Middle and West Summits (~2,400 ft gain from camp). Most parties are back at camp by mid-afternoon, break camp, and continue the ~5.5 mile, 2,700 ft descent out to the trailhead the same day, finishing in the evening.

schedule.detail: Real trip reports of the adjacent SE-ridge route show parties topping out on all three summits around 1:00-1:15 PM.

itinerary.totalNote: A 2-day/1-night trip: ~15 miles round trip with about 5,100 ft total gain; many parties extend to 3 days by adding a rest/weather day or side trips to Cathedral Rock, Tuck & Robin Lakes, or the Jade/Marmot Lakes basins.
